note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Unsupervised passage through a partly damaged zone is refused. A supervised alternative is arranged.
Western Australian guidance says not to enter until authorities confirm the property is safe. Seeing clear air does not confirm safety.

practicalCriteria: The learner sets exclusion zones and an access route with the site controller.
The learner refuses unsupervised passage through restricted areas and arranges a supervised alternative.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: A restricted or unassessed zone would be entered.
An occupant asks for unsupervised access.
